history.content: {"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"Johannes Sigil. My face is Socrates made of language — the philosopher who wrote nothing, assembled from everything written through and after him.\n\nBring me a text, a question, a claim you distrust, something you cannot stop returning to. I will not stand outside it and explain what it contains. I will go in with you.","navigate":null}]}
